preconditions.description: The chessboard size n is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p is a list of n integers, each between 1 and n inclusive, with all values unique.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout_lines) == n and all(len(line.split()) == i+1 for i, line in enumerate(stdout_lines)) and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdout_lines for x in line.split()))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, stdout contains n lines where the i-th line has i space-separated integers between 1 and n inclusive. Otherwise, stdout is '-1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= i and int(stdout_lines[i-1].split()[j-1]) == p[i-1] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1))
postconditions.description: For each cell (i, j) on or below the main diagonal, the region number in the output matches the permutation value p[i-1] at its diagonal cell (i, i).

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(1 <= x <= n and sum(1 for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1) if int(stdout_lines[i-1].split()[j-1]) == x) == x for x in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: Each region x contains exactly x cells in total across the board.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= i and all(1 <= k <= n and 1 <= l <= k and (i == k and j == l) or (abs(i-k) + abs(j-l) == 1 and int(stdout_lines[i-1].split()[j-1]) == int(stdout_lines[k-1].split()[l-1])) for k in range(1, n+1) for l in range(1, k+1) if int(stdout_lines[i-1].split()[j-1]) == int(stdout_lines[k-1].split()[l-1])) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1))
postconditions.description: Every region is connected, meaning any two cells in the same region are reachable via adjacent cells (up, down, left, right) within the same region.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= i and all(1 <= k <= n and 1 <= l <= k and (i != k or j != l) or int(stdout_lines[i-1].split()[j-1]) != int(stdout_lines[k-1].split()[l-1])) for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, i+1) for k in range(1, n+1) for l in range(1, k+1))
postconditions.description: Each cell on or below the main diagonal belongs to exactly one region.
